notes.title: Patch Notes v1.03
notes.content:
A Patch Has Been Released!

Patch Notes v1.03
- Increased the reinforcement success rate
- Fixed auto-save bug
- Fixed minor bugs
- Improved stability of the game client


*If the desktop icon does not show up after update, please refresh steam files as described here:
https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=3134-TIAL-4638
